player_prompt.intro:
A siɗaa Slitherlink e janngude {R}x{C}!
Writi kuuje e janngude ɗee ɓurɗe heewde bee ɗon haala maaɗe.
Toggli kuuje ngam:
  [h r c] - toggli kuuje ngelngel ngal hawri e ɗuuɗe e silte r, kolom c
  [v r c] - toggli kuuje arde e ngal hawri e ɗuuɗe e silte r, kolom c
Namaje maaɗe bee ɗon haala maaɗe, '.' ina woodi bee ɗon haala.
A siɗaa {max_turns} janngude baɗee ko ɗum woni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Molte e janngude. Ɓe [h row col] ko [v row col].

outcome.win: A waɗi dabare go'o! Ɗolum solli.
